content.text: Section 18 covers all preferred limits. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 already contains a Vendor-side insurance covenant matching or exceeding our preferred position: CGL of USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate, professional E&O of USD 2M, cyber and privacy liability of USD 5M (required unconditionally, not only where Customer Data is processed), plus workers' compensation as required by law and employer's liability of USD 1M. Coverage runs through the term and for one year afterward, as in our model language. Section 18.2 adds certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirms that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. All obligations bind the Vendor and benefit us, so no redline is needed.
